semiconductor_relevance: High — the company develops specialized microwave systems for plasma processing used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: S-TEAM Lab, spol. s.r.o. specializes in high-power microwave systems for plasma generation, crucial for semiconductor processes like CVD and plasma etching. Their products, including HOMER autotuners and analyzers, enable efficient impedance matching and power measurement in dynamic plasma environments, serving global OEMs and fabs.
capabilities: High-power microwave systems for plasma generation
HOMER autotuners for automatic impedance matching

regional_presence.Europe: The company serves clients across the EU, indicating a strong presence in the European semiconductor market.
regional_presence.United States: They also cater to customers in the US, reflecting their global outreach.
